title: Anonymous /rest/authenticate JSON body is fully buffered and parsed before authentication
entry: POST /rest/authenticate with a large non-form JSON body
sink: RequestWrapperFilter.RequestWrapper reads full body; AuthenticateProcessorImpl creates JsonServletRequestWrapper which reads String/byte[] and Jackson Map
driver: request body byte volume, JSON object/key count, parser work
retention: request-burst only, during servlet filter/controller authentication processing
bound: multipart and form bodies are skipped by RequestWrapperFilter; no application-level JSON body cap was found in application.yml/application-docker.yml/nginx.conf; default compose also publishes backend 8080 directly
impact: static evidence for unauthenticated request-burst heap pressure; needs dynamic measurement before promotion to likely/confirmed DoS
dynamic_probe: send increasing JSON bodies with mode=password to /rest/authenticate under a capped heap; compare backend 8080 direct and nginx 80 path; success requires GC death/OOM/thread starvation or sustained unavailability, not only one failed request
